title: Stationary sweep configuration update
statement: Let $A$ and $S$ be types, let $x$ be a finite list of symbols from $A$, and choose optional states $q,q'$, an input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ positions, an integer frontier $z$, two finite lists $l,r$ of possibly blank symbols from $A$, and an output word $out$. Applying the one-tape action that keeps both heads stationary, makes no write, emits no output, and enters state $q'$ to the configuration with state $q$ and zipper tape determined by $z,l,r$ gives the configuration with state $q'$ and all other data unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions
$l,r$ are finite lists of possibly blank symbols over $A$
$out$ is a finite output word over $A$
replaced:
Applying a stationary phase-change action — no write, no head movement, no output — to a
forward-facing zipper configuration replaces only the control state and leaves the tape,
input head, and output unchanged.
